description: Source code for certificate verification using path building in Chromium project, including functions for certificate parsing, chain dumping, fingerprinting, and verification logic.

methods.name: AddPemEncodedCert
methods.description: Encodes a ParsedCertificate to PEM and adds to chain.

methods.name: DumpParsedCertificateChain
methods.description: Dumps a chain of certificates to a PEM file.

methods.name: FingerPrintParsedCertificate
methods.description: Computes SHA256 fingerprint of a certificate.

methods.name: SubjectToString
methods.description: Converts parsed subject RDNSequence to string.

methods.name: SubjectFromParsedCertificate
methods.description: Gets subject string from a parsed certificate.

methods.name: PrintResultPath
methods.description: Prints details of a certificate path result.

methods.name: VerifyUsingPathBuilder
methods.description: Verifies a certificate using path building, with chain and trust store setup, and optional dumping of chain.
